Lessons.Title: Ways to Look at Triangles
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will classify triangles based on the your side lengths and the size of your angles.
In the previous lesson, you sorted and categorized two-dimensional shapes using any attribute of your choice. In this lesson, you narrow the set of shapes to triangles. You analyze and sort triangles based on your sides and angles.

2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up: Number Talk: Sums and Products (10 minutes); Activity 1: Triangle Hunt (25 minutes); Activity 2: The Right Kind of Triangle (10 minutes); Cool-down: Which Would Fit in the Set? (5 minutes)
Source-goal geometric reasoning: Classify triangles by side lengths and by angle sizes; a right triangle contains exactly one right angle.

Edulytics worked explanation: Read the source triangle card's side and angle markings. Check whether the triangle has a 90° angle. Separately classify equal side lengths: equilateral, isosceles or scalene. A 30°–60°–90° triangle has three different angles and is right scalene.
First-party Edulytics Cool-down (not gated original): Classify a triangle with angles 30°, 60° and 90°.
Original student diagrams, teacher card sorting, paper folding, and physical drawings require figure-by-figure / teacher validation.
